Help

GroupToDo stores your tasks, projects, and reference material as plain Markdown files in your own folders. Every change writes directly back to disk. Built on Getting Things Done (GTD) principles, it is designed to get things out of your head and into a trusted system with minimal friction.

Capture & Navigation

  • The stages (1–4): Capture · Clarify is the journal; Ctrl+I captures from anywhere, and the inbox can be worked as a list or one card at a time. Organize holds projects, contexts, people, lists and horizons. Review is the weekly review. Engage shows only the next actions you can do in your active context. The app opens on Engage, or on the journal while a meeting from your calendar is going on.
  • Clarify keys: the card is 5 and the decisions sit around it like the numpad: 7 Trash, 8 Someday/maybe, 9 Keep as a note; 4 Next action (context), 6 Project; 1 Done in two minutes, 2 Waiting for, 3 Calendar. 5 puts the card at the back and a click on its text rewords it.
  • Active context: top right, or @@. Say where you are, and Engage lists what can be done there, each with its project and what done looks like.
  • Quick capture (Ctrl+I or N): a box opens over whatever you are doing; Enter puts the line in the inbox and you stay where you were. Names, contexts, and dates parse automatically as you type.
  • Search (/): Find any action or page, or paste a file path to open it directly.
  • Sidebar (\): Access your core views. Hide with ⇤ or \; reopen with ☰.
  • History (Alt+← / Alt+→): Navigate back and forward across all views and pages.
  • Profile: Click GroupToDo (top left) to view your personal notes, backlinks, and set area-specific profile pictures.
  • Storage & Sync: Click the folder path at the bottom of the sidebar to manage local folders, vault files, and sync settings.

Clarify & Organize (Writing on a Line)

Click any line to write or clarify. A menu appears below the line to assign GTD metadata:

  • Triggers: Type @ for people, @@ for contexts, # for projects, and [[ for pages. In the box at the top, a context you already have works as the last word too: Call Mia about the VAT phone tomorrow.
  • Auto-linking: Known names are suggested as you type (Tab to accept). Full names link automatically when you leave the line.
  • Dates: Type natural dates (tomorrow, friday, in 3 days) and press Tab. Placing a date at the end of a task sets its due date.
  • Waiting For: Setting a line's state to Waiting prompts you to assign the person you are waiting on.

Engage (Views)

Today

  • Overview: Displays overdue and due-today items first, followed by the next 7 days, then your daily journals per Area. (On wide screens, journals appear side by side.)
  • Focus (Zoom): Click any bullet to focus exclusively on that branch. Use the breadcrumb trail at the top to zoom back out.
  • Fold: Click a section title or arrow to collapse or expand it.
  • History: Next to the date, scroll backward day-by-day through past activity.

Contexts (c/)

  • Contexts represent the tools or locations required to take action.
  • Each context is a page under c/. Click a context to see all available Next Actions for that situation. Add icon:: on the page to give it an icon.

Projects

  • Status by Folder: A project's status matches the folder its file lives in: Active, Waiting for, Someday/Maybe, Completed, or Cancelled. Drag cards on the board to change status; all links update automatically.
  • Auto-Waiting: If all open next actions in a project are waiting on someone, the project automatically marks itself as Waiting for (auto).
  • Timeline (v t): View and drag project bars to adjust schedules.
  • Report (v r): Review completed outcomes by date range. Use Copy as text for status updates.

People & Organizations

  • Delegate: On the People board, drag a person onto a Next Action to hand it off (moving it to Waiting for), or onto a Project to involve them. Organizations work the same way for projects.
  • External Updates: Requesting an update from someone outside an Area generates a check-in sheet for them.

Areas of Focus & Horizons

  • Areas (Horizon 2): Each Area is a dedicated folder (shared with relevant people) representing an ongoing sphere of responsibility. Its responsibilities are pages under a/.
  • Filtering: Use the top-right checkboxes to filter views by one or more Areas. When multiple Areas are active, items display color-coded tags. Click an Area's name to make it the default destination for new captures.
  • Horizons Ladder: Connects daily actions to your overarching purpose. Purpose and Vision live in your primary home Area; Goals aggregate across all Areas. Open any Area in Horizon 2 to edit its specific horizons.

Reflect (Weekly Review)

  • Structured into three GTD phases: Get Clear, Get Current, Get Creative.
  • Check off steps as you go; linked steps take you directly to the relevant tool view. Customize the checklist under Routines & lists > Weekly review.
  • Project Review (Solitaire Mode): Review active projects one card at a time, starting with the stalest. Filter to include Waiting for or Someday/Maybe lists, and drag or click to update project properties from that Area's most-used options. While you drag, only the box you aim at grows, and the option nearest the pointer grows inside it, with an arrow saying what letting go will do. A card is done when every field is answered, or at once when you mark the project Completed or Cancelled; Skip sends it to the end of the deck.
  • Solitaire keys: each numpad key opens the box in the same place on the table: 7 8 9 Organisations, People, Responsibility; 4 5 6 Next action, Done when, Deadline; 1 Comes after, 2 back to the card, 3 the status. From the card ↑ ← → open Organisations, Comes after and the status too. Inside a box the arrows move between its options and Enter or Space takes one. 1–5 on the number row set the status. Esc goes back to the card, and Shift+→ flings it on as reviewed.

Keyboard Shortcuts

Line Actions

KeyAction
Alt+TToggle between Task and Note
Alt+1Convert line to a Project and link it
Ctrl+EnterCycle state: To Do → Doing → Waiting → Done → Note
Alt+D / C / P / O / J / RSet Due date, Context, Person, Organization, Project, or Repeat
Tab / Shift+TabAccept suggestion / Indent or Outdent
Alt+Shift+↑ / ↓Move line and its sub-items up or down
Alt+SMove line to another Area
↑ / ↓ / Enter / EscNavigate, select, or close an open line menu

Global Navigation

KeyAction
NCapture a new task
/Search
\Toggle sidebar
?Open Help
TGo to Today
@@Switch current Context
g n · g w · g pGo to Next Actions, Waiting For, or Projects
g c · g rGo to Chat or Weekly Review
g hRecently done: what you finished, to add a comment to
v b · v t · v rView Next Actions as Board, Timeline, or Report
v g · v mView Mind Map or Graph
Ctrl+ZUndo last delete or move
EscClose active panel, menu, or Help
